subject.title: fix(synology-chat): bound outbound NAS response bodies to prevent Gateway OOM

question: After removing the unnecessary chatbot-body limit, should Synology Chat adopt 1 MiB and 15 seconds as hard `user_list` response boundaries?
rationale: The response must be bounded, but current code and docs do not establish which large or slow Synology user lists remain part of the supported compatibility envelope.

options.title: Keep submitted user-list limits
options.body: Use the proposed 1 MiB and 15-second boundaries with existing cache fallback.

options.title: Recalibrate user-list limits
options.body: Tune the remaining size or duration constants using representative supported Synology deployments.

recommendation.title: Keep submitted user-list limits
recommendation.body: Use the proposed 1 MiB and 15-second boundaries with existing cache fallback.
